description: This file defines enums, data models, and type aliases related to MCP (possibly a communication protocol or API) including server configurations, credentials, and hook request/response objects.

classes.name: MCPTransport
classes.description: Enum for transport methods: sse, http, stdio.

classes.name: MCPSpecVersion
classes.description: Enum for MCP specification versions with specific date strings.

classes.name: MCPPublicServer
classes.description: Model for safe public MCP server parameters.

classes.name: MCPCredentials
classes.description: TypedDict for OAuth and other credentials.

classes.name: MCPStdioConfig
classes.description: TypedDict for configuring stdio command execution.

classes.name: MCPPreCallRequestObject
classes.description: Model for MCP pre-call hook request.

classes.name: MCPPreCallResponseObject
classes.description: Model for MCP pre-call hook response.

classes.name: MCPDuringCallRequestObject
classes.description: Model for MCP during-call hook request.

classes.name: MCPDuringCallResponseObject
classes.description: Model for MCP during-call hook response.

classes.name: MCPPostCallResponseObject
classes.description: Model for MCP post-call hook response containing list of content responses.

methods.name: HiddenParams
methods.description: Constructor or factory for HiddenParams object used in various models.
